inputs.text: A Wisconsin jury found Harry Wait guilty of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge for requesting ballots for Republican Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent. The Racine County jury acquitted him of a second identity theft count after a two-day trial. Wait leads a group that makes false election claims, and he admitted in 2022 that he requested the ballots to try to show the state’s voter registration system was vulnerable to fraud.
